page: Microsoft Azure NC4as_T4_v3 is a virtual machine instance belonging to the NCASv3_T4 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features an x86_64 AMD processor with 4 dedicated vCPUs. The instance is equipped with 28.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 7.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server type includes a single dedicated NVIDIA T4 GPU with 15 GB of VRAM. For local storage, the configuration provides 180 GB of local disk space, and the instance is Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-performance disk attachments. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included in the base configuration.

The hardware profile is designed for workloads requiring GPU acceleration with moderate CPU resources, such as machine learning inference, lightweight graphics rendering, and CUDA-based computational tasks. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance, though the lack of advanced vector extensions like AVX-512 or AMX in the reported CPU flags limits certain CPU-only acceleration tasks.
